tracks.*.provenance.warning: Authored diegetic history only. Never use this field to infer creator, licence, attribution, or distribution authority.

station.name: WORS 1610 — Orison Community Service Frequency
station.legend: A carrier-current station supposedly operated from the Orison laundry room between 1962 and 1999. No transmitter has ever been found. Its signal now travels through radiator risers, disconnected intercom wire, and whichever room is trying hardest not to remember something.
station.player_name: ORISON PORTABLE MUSIC ASSISTANT, MODEL PM-1610

properly_labeled.title: Properly Labeled
properly_labeled.provenance: Pressed for a Queens teachers’ union filing drive; every surviving sleeve has a different catalog number.

kindness_for_the_unseen.title: Kindness for the Unseen
kindness_for_the_unseen.provenance: Recorded after midnight in a hospital cafeteria for staff who never attended the holiday party.

mina_s_midday_quest.title: Mina’s Midday Quest
mina_s_midday_quest.provenance: Theme from an unaired public-access adventure show whose captions described several scenes that were never filmed.

the_third_thread.title: The Third Thread
the_third_thread.provenance: A garment-district strike song duplicated onto red cassettes and passed inside coat linings.

that_was_selection.title: That Was Selection
that_was_selection.provenance: A rejected college-radio ident that somehow lasts thirty seconds longer each time it is rebroadcast.

under_the_canopy.title: Under the Canopy
under_the_canopy.provenance: A botanical-garden benefit single cut while rain drummed on the greenhouse roof.

grease_under_my_nails.title: Grease Under My Nails
grease_under_my_nails.provenance: The B-side of a garage single distributed free with rebuilt alternators on Northern Boulevard.

stripes_of_velvet.title: Stripes of Velvet
stripes_of_velvet.provenance: A one-take demo from a karaoke bar soundcheck; the engineer kept the room noise and erased the applause.

the_quarterly_audit.title: The Quarterly Audit
the_quarterly_audit.provenance: Corporate training music commissioned by a stationery firm that dissolved before approving the final invoice.

a_threat_in_the_blue.title: A Threat in the Blue
a_threat_in_the_blue.provenance: A courier mixtape instrumental timed to one impossible eleven-minute run from Astoria to the Village.

felt_correct.title: Felt Correct
felt_correct.provenance: An unsigned museum-acoustics demonstration discovered inside a mislabeled textile sample box.

after_the_last_elevator.title: After the Last Elevator
after_the_last_elevator.provenance: A four-track apartment recording made during an overnight elevator outage; the final footstep is on the wrong floor.

a_calculated_deviation.title: A Calculated Deviation
a_calculated_deviation.provenance: Music from a withdrawn city-planning CD-ROM that taught children to report impossible angles.

the_space_between.title: The Space Between
the_space_between.artist: Cal Dwyer and the Dead Frequencies
the_space_between.provenance: Cut from the silence between two family-voice tapes; Cal insists he never recorded it.

glorious_stain.title: Glorious Stain
glorious_stain.provenance: A gallery-opening giveaway made from contact microphones taped to wet canvases.

the_discipline_of_shadows.title: The Discipline of Shadows
the_discipline_of_shadows.provenance: Score for a student documentary whose negatives show a crew member absent from the shoot.

no_subject_line.title: No Subject Line
no_subject_line.provenance: Emailed to six literary magazines with no attachment; all six editors remember hearing it.

ancient_angles.title: Ancient Angles
ancient_angles.provenance: A private-press antiquarian lecture accompaniment with a provenance older than the magnetic tape carrying it.

am_maintenance.title: A.M. Maintenance
am_maintenance.provenance: An unofficial morning theme played over the Orison intercom until management denied owning an intercom.

amber_rivers.title: Amber Rivers
amber_rivers.provenance: A summer single remembered mostly through open apartment windows and one warped eight-track.

bloom_in_the_quiet.title: Bloom in the Quiet
bloom_in_the_quiet.provenance: Written for a community garden memorial where nobody agreed whose memory was being honored.

desk_lamp_confessions.title: Desk Lamp Confessions
desk_lamp_confessions.provenance: A late-night office-radio request recorded after the host forgot the microphone was live.

glass_orchard.title: Glass Orchard
glass_orchard.provenance: Made from greenhouse panes, wineglasses, and a storm recorded three days before it occurred.

golden_hour_blinds.title: Golden Hour Blinds
golden_hour_blinds.provenance: The companion single to “Amber Rivers,” found behind venetian blinds during a 5B repaint.

gravity_in_the_grain.title: Gravity in the Grain
gravity_in_the_grain.provenance: A carpenter’s rhythm study sampled from joists in three condemned Queens row houses.

linen_and_salt.title: Linen and Salt
linen_and_salt.provenance: A wash-day instrumental sold with a booklet on removing blood, wine, and family expectations.

living_with_the_motor.title: Living with the Motor
living_with_the_motor.provenance: Recorded beside an overworked freight elevator and dedicated to everyone who learned to sleep through it.

paper_sleep.title: Paper Sleep
paper_sleep.provenance: A lullaby assembled from filing cabinets closing on six different floors.

porcelain_blooms.title: Porcelain Blooms
porcelain_blooms.provenance: Bedroom-pop recorded through a teacup pressed against a radiator pipe.

rest_within_the_tide.title: Rest Within the Tide
rest_within_the_tide.provenance: The closing music for a late-night weather report that forecast emotional rather than atmospheric pressure.

signed_in_white.title: Signed in White
signed_in_white.provenance: A contract-law folk song whose original acetate bears a signature visible only under dust.

slow_stirring_morning.title: Slow Stirring Morning
slow_stirring_morning.provenance: Recorded around kettle whistles and the first bus braking outside the Orison.

someone_bigger_is_holding.title: Someone Bigger Is Holding
someone_bigger_is_holding.provenance: A comfort song commissioned for children during a blackout, then banned because adults found it unsettling.

velvet_firelight.title: Velvet Firelight
velvet_firelight.provenance: A dressing-room B-side recorded with the club’s power off and every mirror covered.

waiting_for_the_cloudburst.title: Waiting for the Cloudburst
waiting_for_the_cloudburst.provenance: An unreleased storm single that WORS plays only when the roof is already wet.

wishes_in_the_glass.title: Wishes in the Glass
wishes_in_the_glass.provenance: A mirrored-bar lounge single whose requests were traditionally written backward on cocktail napkins.

evelyn_marsh.name: Evelyn Marsh
evelyn_marsh.anecdote: I played this while grading the last set of papers I ever assigned. Wrote ‘promising’ on every one. Completely irresponsible. Best professional decision I made.
evelyn_marsh.gift_line: You helped me stop grading my own life. Take my Carbon Copies tracks before I reorganize them again.

teresa_vale.name: Teresa Vale
teresa_vale.anecdote: Night shift, three in the morning. A custodian heard this from my headphones and danced an IV pole down the hall. Nobody smiled, which made it funnier.
teresa_vale.gift_line: These got me through nights that technically had mornings. They’re yours now.

mina_vale.name: Mina Vale
mina_vale.anecdote: I captioned the pilot. The hero said, ‘We ride at noon.’ The waveform clearly said, ‘We hide a spoon.’ They accepted my correction and canceled the series.
mina_vale.gift_line: I added the clean masters. The captions are optional. Emotionally, they are mandatory.

lena_ortiz.name: Lena Ortiz
lena_ortiz.anecdote: My mother hid this cassette inside a winter coat she repaired. I found it ten years later because the left sleeve sang when I raised my arm.
lena_ortiz.gift_line: Good repairs should be shared. So should good songs. I put three in your player.

juno_kells.name: Juno Kells
juno_kells.anecdote: I sampled this ident for a station demo. Every export came back with someone whispering ‘try again.’ Excellent notes, honestly.
juno_kells.gift_line: I made you copies from my least haunted masters. That is not the same as un-haunted.

malcolm_reed.name: Malcolm Reed
malcolm_reed.anecdote: The greenhouse played this at my first propagation workshop. I killed every cutting except one pothos. It’s still alive and extremely smug.
malcolm_reed.gift_line: Plants travel as cuttings. Music travels as copies. These three should take root.

omar_bell.name: Omar Bell
omar_bell.anecdote: My father could diagnose an engine by the bridge. I pretended I could too. We replaced a perfectly good water pump and never discussed it.
omar_bell.gift_line: They run clean now. Don’t over-tighten them, metaphorically or otherwise.

rhea_sato.name: Rhea Sato
rhea_sato.anecdote: That ‘one-take demo’ was take nineteen. Take eighteen was perfect, so naturally I panicked and deleted it. Nineteen had the nerve to survive.
rhea_sato.gift_line: You heard the ugly take and stayed. Fine. You get the whole little trilogy.

peter_wren.name: Peter Wren
peter_wren.anecdote: The city used this in orientation. We marched to Records in formation until someone noticed orientation had ended forty minutes earlier.
peter_wren.gift_line: I have entered three recordings into your personal inventory. No countersignature required.

cam_ortiz.name: Cam Ortiz
cam_ortiz.anecdote: This was on a tape labeled ‘Thirty-Minute Delivery.’ I made the run in twenty-eight and spent the remaining two minutes pretending not to vomit.
cam_ortiz.gift_line: Road music. Keep moving and it can’t catch up. Usually.

noel_price.name: Noel Price
noel_price.anecdote: I cataloged this as a textile sample because the box said felt. Three months later I realized that was an opinion, not a material.
noel_price.gift_line: Their provenance is questionable. Their emotional authenticity is annoyingly excellent. Take them.

transient_guests.name: Transient Guests
transient_guests.anecdote: We heard this in a hotel elevator in a city none of us can name. It stopped at our floor. We did not have a floor.
transient_guests.gift_line: We’re checking out. These tracks already think your player is their room.

nadia_quell.name: Nadia Quell
nadia_quell.anecdote: I used this to pace a tenant march. The route formed a perfect violation symbol on the map. Planning denied the symbol existed, which proved our point.
nadia_quell.gift_line: I’ve transferred three exhibits to your device. Back them up somewhere outside municipal reality.

cal_dwyer.name: Cal Dwyer
cal_dwyer.anecdote: That’s my mother’s tape machine clicking at the start. I know because it always clicked twice. Here it clicks three times. I try not to count.
cal_dwyer.gift_line: The signal chose you. I’m merely making the unauthorized duplication official.

iris_bell.name: Iris Bell
iris_bell.anecdote: I spilled ultramarine over the master at the release party. Everyone thought it was deliberate. That was the first compliment I believed by accident.
iris_bell.gift_line: These are the versions with fingerprints. The clean ones never looked right.

sacha_reed.name: Sacha Reed
sacha_reed.anecdote: I shot the documentary stills. One shadow faced the camera in every frame. Its owner never did. The director called that visual consistency.
sacha_reed.gift_line: Three tracks, original sequence. Please don’t crop the silence.

jonah_price.name: Jonah Price
jonah_price.anecdote: I opened the email because it had no subject. That felt honest. I listened six times and wrote the best first paragraph of a book I never started.
jonah_price.gift_line: They have beginnings and endings, which is more than I usually manage. They’re yours.

mae_kessler.name: Mae Kessler
mae_kessler.anecdote: The tape claims 1962. The melody appears in an 1891 auction ledger. I bought both because skepticism is expensive when practiced correctly.
mae_kessler.gift_line: I cannot certify these recordings. I can certify that I would be furious if you lost them.
